title: CensusStatisticalUnit
description: A statistical unit declaration. Every estimate must declare exactly one unit. Units cannot be mixed silently. See CENSUS §46-56.

unitId.description: Stable identifier referenced by estimates and populations.

unitType.description: Canonical unit type. Must not be mixed with other types without explicit conversion.

dimensionType.description: STOCK = counted at a point/period. FLOW = events through time. NEVER mix without explicit model.

flowPeriod.description: Required when FLOW. e.g. 'per_year'. null when STOCK.

parentUnitId.description: If this unit is contained by another (ESTABLISHMENT parent=ENTERPRISE). Prevents 1 enterprise = 1 establishment assumption.

incompatibleWith.description: Unit IDs that cannot be arithmetically combined without explicit conversion.
